clawapi-skill 1.3.0 — Major documentation and configuration update

- Added comprehensive, user-friendly SKILL.md with full model descriptions, agent roles, configuration, usage rules, and pricing information.
- Clarified environment variable requirements and agent default setup for easy integration.
- Explained decision flow, delegation, error handling, and refueling rules for OPC (“One Person Company”) workflows.
- Listed 8 official models across 4 providers, each mapped to a virtual AI company role (CEO, CTO, CMO, CFO, etc.).
- Provided transparent on-chain pricing, onboarding bonuses, and usage instructions for new users.
